extracted.intended_audience: general readers of early-18th-century periodicals; literary-historical readers and scholars of Steele/Swift
extracted.subtask_description: Digitized excerpt of early-18th-century periodical essays (The Spectator/Tatler-style) with editorial footnotes; aimed at readers and scholars interested in historical literary content and commentary. The page presents narrative pieces, newsy dispatches, and literary anecdotes rather than evaluation criteria.
